senses.en: to go through a bush without a path

records.text: tuhuling marizaux maxatukul paasakelay di puupuh raxung

senses.zh: 他穿過灌樹叢，在山裡爬上爬下，終於到了河的起源地
senses.en: He went through bushes, descended and ascended mountains and (finally) arrived at the origin of the river

records.text: taxu pasakenay adang a kawas ka, itukuun saw lia ki kalayu

senses.zh: 快到一年時， Kalayu 懷孕了
senses.en: In less than a year, Kalayu became pregnant.

records.text: apa'en namisiw a ina mukusa di taubur a mituku

senses.zh: 由她的媽媽揹著去會場坐
senses.en: (She was) arried on back by her mother to go to the gathering place, (and) sit (there).

records.text: mituku di saw a lakang ki rakihan

senses.en: The child sat between the people.
sat there and stayed motionless there
Asilu had come to sit here before.

senses.zh: 有座位，別站在那兒，坐在這兒
senses.en: There is a seat. Don't stand there. Sit here.
